Japan's tax-free shopping changes on 1 November 2026.

Before: the 10% came off at the till.
After: you pay the full price, then claim the 10% back at the airport before you fly.

Budget for the full amount up front.

What changes → gentlyyonder.com/go/tax

Before you choose a Tokyo hotel, choose the station.

First trip: Shinjuku's south or west side, or Shibuya.
Shinkansen days: Tokyo Station, Marunouchi side.
Old Tokyo, better value: Asakusa or Ueno.

Then book within five minutes of it.

gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-tokyo

Honest question for anyone who has been back to the same country twice:

What did you do differently the second time?

Ours: fewer cities, more nights in each, and a hotel near the station we actually used.

Japan's departure tax tripled on 1 July 2026: ¥1,000 → ¥3,000 per person.

There's no queue or machine for it at the airport. It's built into your plane or ferry ticket.

If a fare out of Japan looks a little higher than last year, this is part of why.

Where to stay in Kyoto, in one line: downtown, between Karasuma and Kawaramachi.

Two subway lines and two private railways meet there, Nishiki Market and the river are on foot, and you spend less of your trip waiting for buses.

gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-kyoto

Booking a DMZ tour from Seoul? Read the title twice.

The JSA at Panmunjom, with the blue huts, has been closed to civilian tours since July 2023. A "DMZ & JSA" promise can't be kept.

And check for a shopping stop before you compare prices.

gentlyyonder.com/go/dmz

Korea trip early next year? Check this in December.

Travellers from 22 countries, including the US, UK, Canada, Australia and Japan, don't need a K-ETA until 31 December 2026.

No extension has been announced yet. Korea has extended it before.

gentlyyonder.com/go/keta

Tokyo to Kyoto, three ways:

Shinkansen: about 2h 15m and about ¥14,170, city centre to city centre.
Flying via Osaka: roughly twice as long, door to door.
Overnight bus: the budget option.

We'd take the train.

gentlyyonder.com/go/tokyo-kyoto

Our Sydney pick, and one of us has stayed there (paid our own way):

Sheraton Grand Sydney Hyde Park.

On the park, a couple of minutes from St James and Museum stations, with a rooftop pool and Circular Quay a few stops away.

gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-sydney

Osaka has two centres. Pick the one that fits.

Namba and Shinsaibashi: food, nightlife, Nankai trains to the airport.
Umeda: JR to Kyoto and Kobe, and the Haruka from Kansai Airport.

The Midosuji line links them in about ten minutes.

gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-osaka

Flying to Singapore? File the SG Arrival Card in the three days before you land. The day you arrive counts as one of them.

It's free on ICA's own website or the MyICA app. Paid services aren't needed.

Travellers who skip it may be refused entry.

What's the one thing you packed for your last trip and never used?

And the one thing you wished you'd brought?

Kyoto's hotel tax, per person, per night, since 1 March 2026:

Under ¥6,000: ¥200
¥6,000–19,999: ¥400
¥20,000–49,999: ¥1,000
¥50,000–99,999: ¥4,000
¥100,000 and up: ¥10,000

Usually added to your bill at check-out.

Booking a Tokyo food tour? Choose the neighbourhood and the hour before the company.

Shinjuku's izakaya alleys: evening.
Tsukiji: morning.
Asakusa: old-town snacks.

Then compare the same tour on Viator and Klook. Prices differ during sales.

gentlyyonder.com/go/foodtour

First time in Melbourne? Stay inside the Free Tram Zone.

Trams in the city centre are free, the SkyBus from the airport stops at Southern Cross on its edge, and most of what you'll want is a short ride away.

gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-mel

Eurail is now Interrail: since 9 September 2026, one pass range for everyone.

A pass wins for long trips across several countries, loose plans, children aged 4–11 or under-28s.

On a fixed route, advance tickets are often cheaper.

gentlyyonder.com/go/eurail

Vietnam has no single best month: north, centre and south have different weather.

For a north-to-south trip, late February to April and October to November compromise least.

May to September is cheaper and greener, with afternoon rain.

gentlyyonder.com/go/vn-when

Three things get easier with Japan's tax-free shopping from 1 November:

No more sealed bags for cosmetics and snacks.
One set of rules instead of two.
No ¥500,000 cap on consumables.

The catch: you pay the 10% first and claim it back at the airport.

Going to Bali? Budget for the tourist levy: IDR 150,000 per person, paid once per trip.

Pay it only on the official Love Bali website, run by Bali's provincial government. Lookalike sites exist.

There are also payment counters at Bali's airport and port.

If you stay in Asakusa, set one alarm for 7 a.m.

At that hour the Senso-ji precinct is close to empty. By late morning it's crowded.

It's the strongest case for staying on that side of Tokyo.

Staying at Bondi in Sydney? Know the commute first.

There's no train to the beach: it's a train to Bondi Junction, then a bus.

Perfect for a swim before breakfast. Less so if most of your plans are in the city.

Taiwan's high-speed rail 3-Day Pass (NT$2,200) is the one most visitors buy, and it often loses.

Taipei–Kaohsiung and back: NT$2,980 standard, about NT$1,938 Early Bird, about NT$1,266 each on a buy-one-get-one pair.

The discounts don't stack.

gentlyyonder.com/go/thsr

First thing to buy in Hong Kong: an Octopus card, the tap-and-go card that works on almost everything.

Then cross the harbour on the Star Ferry at least once after dark. It has been running since 1888.

gentlyyonder.com/go/hk

A good-value harbour trip in Sydney: the commuter ferry to Manly.

About half an hour from Circular Quay, past the Opera House and out towards the Heads.

Stay in Manly and that's your daily ride into town.

Send this to whoever you're travelling with:

Screenshot the first night's address in the local language.
Know how you're getting from the airport.
Withdraw a little local cash on arrival.
Plan nothing big for day one.

The first-trip checklist → gentlyyonder.com/go/ft

No need for a dinner cruise to see Bangkok from the river.

The Chao Phraya Express Boat, a public commuter service, runs the same water for a normal fare. The ICONSIAM shuttle from Sathorn crosses it free.

Ride up to Tha Tien for Wat Pho.

gentlyyonder.com/go/bkk-river

Café de l'Ambre in Ginza has served coffee, and only coffee, since 1948.

Around 30 single origins, one blend, and beans aged for decades.

Order, sit, and don't hurry. That's the point.

Nine old Tokyo coffee houses → gentlyyonder.com/go/kissaten

A Europe trip across several countries? One regional eSIM usually covers it.

Check that non-EU stops such as Switzerland, the UK or the Balkans are included.

For one to two weeks of moderate use, 10–20 GB is typical.

gentlyyonder.com/go/esim-eu

One city for a week, or three cities in a week?

We know which we'd pick. We'd like to hear the case for three.

A Ha Long Bay day trip from Hanoi is mostly a bus ride.

The bay is about 200 km away and the road takes at least three hours each way: roughly six hours in a vehicle around four to eight on the water.

A night on the bay changes that sum.

gentlyyonder.com/go/halong

Day tour from Taipei?

KKday for Taroko Gorge, Sun Moon Lake, Alishan and night markets. Klook for the Jiufen–Shifen–Yehliu loop, where listings often include Yehliu entry.

Prices usually differ by under 5%, so compare what's included.

gentlyyonder.com/go/taipei-tours

Day trip to Mount Fuji from Tokyo? Where you stay matters.

Highway buses to Fuji leave from Busta Shinjuku, above Shinjuku Station's south exit.

Stay on that side and you can walk to the bus.
